title: $SOAG · Week 1
subtitle: Solana Agent — three agents, one token. What shipped this week.

flow.label: Launch
flow.desc: pump.fun bonding curve → graduated to PumpSwap

flowNote: The loop: hold $SOAG → lock in SOAG Vault → mint a Barutan badge → multiply your Holder Hunt payouts → more $SOAG → lock more. Each piece is on-chain verifiable; every payout has a tx hash.

family.name: Mirror Deployer
family.desc: Paste any pump.fun deployer wallet. Get reputation score, archetype, AI thesis, rug pattern. The pre-buy diligence you used to do manually on Solscan.

family.name: Holder Hunt
family.desc: Daily wallet-analysis quiz in $SOAG TG. Drops a target wallet at 00:00 + 12:00 UTC. Solve with Mirror Agent. Top scorers split a $SOAG pot.

family.name: SOAG Vault
family.desc: Streamflow lockup of $SOAG → mint soulbound Barutan-claw NFT badge. Badge multiplies your Holder Hunt payouts. No second token, no inflation.

family.name: Barutan Agent
family.desc: Group mascot agent in TG. Runs locally on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W via Groq API. Ask it things. Same character as the Vault NFT badges.

family.name: Pumpscan
family.desc: Solana wallet/token analyzer. Bundler detection, holder concentration, dev wallet status. Powers the Holder Hunt quiz workflow.

family.name: Mirror Marketplace
family.desc: Subscribe to top traders' AI-generated theses. Beta — payment flow under construction. Discovery surface live; SOL subscriptions coming.

tiersNote: Badges are soulbound (non-transferable). The lock is via Streamflow; the badge is a cNFT minted on lock confirmation. Multiplier applies to every Holder Hunt payout while the badge is held. Same Barutan character as the Telegram mascot agent — one IP, two surfaces.
